The '''Qua'Tahc meleenium heist''' was an operation undertaken by [[Rani Quanic]], [[Ostan Atur]], and [[Talak]]. They targeted the [[Qua'Tahc]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]], stealing 100 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]].
